question: 为什么 2026 年 8 月北京销售额相比 7 月下降？请进一步诊断主要影响因素。

inspection_outcome.user_message: 销售额从233378.95变为120953.99，下降112424.96，幅度约48.17%。变化方向得到支持，可以继续分析变化来源；是否属于历史异常尚未评估。

sql_by_period.2026-08:
SELECT
  ds.store_name AS dimension_value,
  SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS value
FROM dim_store ds
LEFT JOIN fact_order fo
  ON fo.store_id = ds.store_id
 AND fo.order_status = '已完成'
 AND fo.pay_time >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00'
 AND fo.pay_time < '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
WHERE ds.city = '北京'
GROUP BY ds.store_name
sql_by_period.2026-07:
SELECT
  s.store_name AS dimension_value,
  SUM(o.pay_amount) AS `value`
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN fact_order o
  ON s.store_id = o.store_id
 AND o.order_status = '已完成'
 AND o.pay_time >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
 AND o.pay_time < '2026-08-01 00:00:00'
WHERE s.city = '北京'
GROUP BY s.store_name

sql_by_period.2026-08:
SELECT p.promo_name AS dimension_value, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS value
FROM fact_order o
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN dim_promotion p ON o.promo_id = p.promo_id
WHERE o.order_status = '已完成'
  AND o.pay_time >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND s.city = '北京'
  AND s.store_name = '北京王府井旗舰店'
GROUP BY p.promo_name
sql_by_period.2026-07:
SELECT
    dp.promo_name AS dimension_value,
    SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS `value`
FROM fact_order fo
LEFT JOIN dim_promotion dp
    ON fo.promo_id = dp.promo_id
INNER JOIN dim_store ds
    ON fo.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE fo.order_status = '已完成'
  AND fo.pay_time >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND fo.pay_time < '2026-08-01 00:00:00'
  AND ds.city = '北京'
  AND ds.store_name = '北京王府井旗舰店'
GROUP BY dp.promo_name
ORDER BY dp.promo_name IS NULL, dp.promo_name

decisions.reason: 用户未指定具体维度，需先定位北京销售额下降的主要影响因素；首选门店维度，按门店拆解 2026 年 8 月相比 7 月的销售额变化，识别下降集中在哪些门店。
上一轮显示北京王府井旗舰店降幅最大（-67,403.55，贡献率59.95%），下钻至该门店查看促销活动对销售额下降的影响。
已完成下钻诊断：北京8月销售额下降主要来自北京王府井旗舰店，减少67,403.55，贡献约59.95%；该店下降又主要受促销活动缺失/减弱影响，其中春季焕新季88折减少26,127.06（贡献38.76%）、常态无优惠减少21,927.82（贡献32.53%）、周末会员专属狂欢券减少12,667.14（贡献18.79%）。其他门店也有下降但贡献较小。因此主要影响因素为王府井门店及促销活动类别。
